replies.author: ViceTechnicolour
replies.body: We shouldn't treat players differently like that, if you're implying he should only be tempbanned. Most advertising cases are a permanent ban, and tempbanning him would be unfair. You also don't know if he'd do it again or not, and as always an appropriate punishment will be dealt. Thanks for the report and hopefully a staff member will get to you shortly.
